RQ 3: We will conduct single-case change point analyses for participants in which significant changes in mean level or slope were detected by the PDT and/or ITSA (RQ2). Data will be analysed with Wild Binary Segmentation (WBS) [62]. 
> WBS has no assumptions. 
> It tests for change points by splitting the longitudinal observations into random intervals. 
> Per individual, the analysis gives insight into the exact moment of change (both level and slope) for each outcome.  


This will provide us with information on which Booster intervention stages or elements were relevant to changes in the study outcomes across individuals.
strenghts
- random intervals - can detect close togehter change points
- does not require choice of window parameter
- easy and not computational complex

sharma:  DOI: 10.1007/s40974-016-0011-1
The R package, WBS, is available with two methods, Standard Binary Segmentation (SBS) and Wild Binary Segmentation (WBS)
Baranowski R, Fryzlewicz P (2014) wbs: wild binary segmentation for multiple change-point detection. R package version 1.1  

wbs stopping criteria (2 options)
1. based on treshold
2. strengthened Schwarz information criterion (sSIC)
--> avoids overdetecting changepoints

https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/wbs/versions/1.4/topics/wbs
--> input = numerical vector, ordered in time. assumes equidistance
--> cannot handle missing data, so need to be umputed

# Changepoint analysis 
M     number of random intervals, recommendation M= 5000 (higher, more comp power needed). M = 0 reduces WBS to BS
C     treshold constant. Should be selected based on simulation. If not wanting to simulate; advice is to use the sSIC
> Computes the residual variance of the fitted piecewise‑constant model.
> Computes a penalty that increases with the number of changepoints.
> Picks the model that gives the lowest sSIC
  
  https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/wbs/versions/1.4/topics/changepoints
  
result :
's' and 'e' denote start- end points of the intervals in which change-points candidates 'cpt' have been found; 
           -->  for each possible split position (n-1) , it provides the strongest interval-based CUSUM statisticm and corresponding s & e (interval)
           --> the split seems to be after the cpt 
column 'CUSUM' contains corresponding value of CUSUM statistic; 
'min.th' is the smallest threshold value for which given change-point candidate would be not added to the set of estimated change-points; 
the last column is the scale at which the change-point has been found
        --> seems to be an approximate ordining. Lower; is stronger change point, earlier found. 
# plot changepoints
```{r}
# Original data
y <- as.numeric(B04$fse_imp)
df_ts <- data.frame(t = seq_along(y), y = y)
# Extract IC-based CPs 
cp <- unlist(ch.B04.fse$cpt.ic, use.names = FALSE)  # the CPs 
cp <- sort(unique(as.integer(cp)))

# data.frame with results
res_df <- as.data.frame(result.B04)

# Keep only the rows for the detected CPs; compute strength = |CUSUM|
hits <- res_df %>%
  filter(cpt %in% cp) %>%
  mutate(strength = abs(CUSUM))

hits <- hits %>%
  arrange(desc(strength))

# 4) Build a label that appears **in the legend**
#    Example: "cp=35  [s=1, e=35]  |CUSUM|=38.98"
hits$label <- with(hits, sprintf("%d [%d;%d], |CUSUM|=%.0f", cpt, s, e, strength))
hits$label <- factor(hits$label, levels = hits$label)  # preserve order in legend

# 5) Plot ONLY the series + dashed CP lines; legend shows interval and |CUSUM|
p <- ggplot(df_ts, aes(t, y)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey20") +
  geom_vline(
    data = hits,
    aes(xintercept = cpt, color = label),
    linetype = 1, linewidth = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
   # intervals [s,e] as light outlines (dashed)
  geom_rect(
    data = hits,
    aes(xmin = s, xmax = e, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, color = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, linetype = 2
  ) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Original data with WBS changepoints",
    x = "Index", y = "Value", color = "CP [interval], |CUSUM|"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3, override.aes = list(linetype = 1, linewidth = 1.2)))

print(p)


table(tb$sent_date == tb$T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date)
```

# FSE 
```{r}
studienummers    <- unique(tb$Studienummer)
cp_results_list  <- list()

for (id in studienummers) {
  
  cat("Processing:", id, "\n")
  
  dat <- tb[tb$Studienummer == id, ]
  y   <- as.numeric(dat$fse_imp)
  

  # ── 1. WBS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  object <- tryCatch(
    wbs(y, M = 5000, rand.intervals = TRUE, integrated = TRUE),
    error = function(e) { message("  WBS failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(object)) next
  
  # ── 2. Changepoints ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ch <- tryCatch(
    changepoints(object, th = NULL, th.const = 1.3, Kmax = 2, penalty = "ssic.penalty"),
    error = function(e) { message("  changepoints() failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(ch)) next
  
  cp <- sort(unique(as.integer(unlist(ch$cpt.ic, use.names = FALSE))))
  
  # ── 3. Vertical line positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # T1_StartMeet: first row where sent_date matches T1_StartMeet_date
  t1_idx <- which(dat$sent_date == dat$T1_StartMeet_date)[1]
  
  # Phase B: first row where phase_FSE == "B"
  phase_B_idx <- which(dat$phase_FSE == "B")[1]
  

  
  # ── 4. Build hits df ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  res_df <- as.data.frame(object$res)
  
  if (length(cp) > 0 && nrow(res_df) > 0) {
    hits <- res_df %>%
      filter(cpt %in% cp) %>%
      mutate(strength = abs(CUSUM)) %>%
      arrange(desc(strength))
    hits$label <- with(hits, sprintf("%d [%d;%d], |CUSUM|=%.0f", cpt, s, e, strength))
    hits$label <- factor(hits$label, levels = hits$label)
  } else {
    hits <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # ── 5. Plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  dfts <- data.frame(t = seq_along(y), y = y)
  
  p <- ggplot(dfts, aes(t, y)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey20")
  
  # Phase B dotted line (black)
  if (!is.na(phase_B_idx)) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = phase_B_idx,
                        linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text", x = phase_B_idx, y = Inf,
               label = "T2", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
               size = 3, color = "black")
  }
  
  # T1_StartMeet dotted line (darkgrey)
  if (!is.na(t1_idx)) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = t1_idx,
                        linetype = "dotted", color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text", x = t1_idx, y = Inf,
               label = "T1", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
               size = 3, color = "darkgrey")
  }
  
  # CP lines + interval rectangles
  if (nrow(hits) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(data = hits, aes(xintercept = cpt, color = label),
                 linetype = 1, linewidth = 1) +
      geom_rect(data = hits,
                aes(xmin = s, xmax = e, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, color = label),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    labs(title = paste(id, "– WBS changepoints (fse_imp)"),
         x = "Time index", y = "fse_imp",
         color = "CP [interval], |CUSUM|") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
          legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.text      = element_text(size = 9)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3,
                                override.aes = list(linetype = 1, linewidth = 1.2)))
  
  plot_path <- file.path(OutDir, paste0(id, "_WBS_fse_imp.png"))
  ggsave(plot_path, plot = p, width = 10, height = 5)
  cat("  Plot saved:", plot_path, "\n")
  
  # ── 6. Collect results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (length(cp) > 0 && nrow(hits) > 0) {
    cp_df <- hits %>%
      select(cpt, s, e, CUSUM, strength) %>%
      mutate(
        Studienummer   = id,
        dep_var        = "fse_imp",
        n_obs          = length(y),
        n_cp           = length(cp),
        penalty        = "ssic.penalty",
        th.const       = 1.3,
        Kmax           = 3,
        time_phase_B   = ifelse(is.na(phase_B_idx), NA_integer_, as.integer(phase_B_idx)),
        time_T1_start  = ifelse(is.na(t1_idx),      NA_integer_, as.integer(t1_idx))
      )
  } else {
    cp_df <- data.frame(
      cpt = NA, s = NA, e = NA, CUSUM = NA, strength = NA,
      Studienummer  = id, dep_var = "fse_imp",
      n_obs         = length(y), n_cp = 0,
      penalty       = "ssic.penalty", th.const = 1.3, Kmax = 2,
      time_phase_B  = ifelse(is.na(phase_B_idx), NA_integer_, as.integer(phase_B_idx)),
      time_T1_start = ifelse(is.na(t1_idx),      NA_integer_, as.integer(t1_idx))
    )
  }
  
  cp_results_list[[id]] <- cp_df
}

# ── 7. Combine & save as Excel ───────────────────────────────────────────────
cp_results_table <- do.call(rbind, cp_results_list)
rownames(cp_results_table) <- NULL

# Reorder columns for readability
cp_results_table <- cp_results_table %>%
  select(Studienummer, dep_var, n_obs, n_cp,
         cpt, s, e, CUSUM, strength,
         time_phase_B, time_T1_start,
         penalty, th.const, Kmax)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "WBS_results")

# Header style
hs <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, textDecoration = "bold",
                  fgFill = "#D9E1F2", halign = "center",
                  border = "Bottom", borderStyle = "medium")

writeData(wb, "WBS_results", cp_results_table, headerStyle = hs)

# Body style
body_style <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10)
addStyle(wb, "WBS_results", body_style,
         rows = 2:(nrow(cp_results_table) + 1),
         cols = 1:ncol(cp_results_table),
         gridExpand = TRUE)

# Highlight the two time columns
highlight <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, fgFill = "#FFF2CC")
addStyle(wb, "WBS_results", highlight,
         rows = 2:(nrow(cp_results_table) + 1),
         cols = which(names(cp_results_table) %in% c("time_phase_B", "time_T1_start")),
         gridExpand = TRUE)

setColWidths(wb, "WBS_results", cols = 1:ncol(cp_results_table), widths = "auto")

xlsx_path <- file.path(OutDir, "2026-04-01_WBS_fse_imp_changepoints.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, xlsx_path, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nResults saved to:", xlsx_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
  cat("Processing:", id, "\n")

  }
```

# satisfaction 
```{r}
#studienummers    <- unique(tb$Studienummer)
cp_results_list  <- list()

for (id in studienummers) {
  
  cat("Processing:", id, "\n")
  
  dat <- tb[tb$Studienummer == id, ]
  y   <- as.numeric(dat$satisfaction_imp)
  

  # ── 1. WBS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  object <- tryCatch(
    wbs(y, M = 5000, rand.intervals = TRUE, integrated = TRUE),
    error = function(e) { message("  WBS failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(object)) next
  
  # ── 2. Changepoints ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ch <- tryCatch(
    changepoints(object, th = NULL, th.const = 1.3, Kmax = 2, penalty = "ssic.penalty"),
    error = function(e) { message("  changepoints() failed: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(ch)) next
  
  cp <- sort(unique(as.integer(unlist(ch$cpt.ic, use.names = FALSE))))
  
  # ── 3. Vertical line positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  # T1_StartMeet: first row where sent_date matches T1_StartMeet_date
  t1_idx <- which(dat$sent_date == dat$T1_StartMeet_date)[1]
  
  # Phase B: first row where phase_health == "B"
  phase_B_idx <- which(dat$phase_satisf_health == "B")[1]
  

  
  # ── 4. Build hits df ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  res_df <- as.data.frame(object$res)
  
  if (length(cp) > 0 && nrow(res_df) > 0) {
    hits <- res_df %>%
      filter(cpt %in% cp) %>%
      mutate(strength = abs(CUSUM)) %>%
      arrange(desc(strength))
    hits$label <- with(hits, sprintf("%d [%d;%d], |CUSUM|=%.0f", cpt, s, e, strength))
    hits$label <- factor(hits$label, levels = hits$label)
  } else {
    hits <- data.frame()
  }
  
  # ── 5. Plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  dfts <- data.frame(t = seq_along(y), y = y)
  
  p <- ggplot(dfts, aes(t, y)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey20")
  
  # Phase B dotted line (black)
  if (!is.na(phase_B_idx)) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = phase_B_idx,
                        linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text", x = phase_B_idx, y = Inf,
               label = "T2", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
               size = 3, color = "black")
  }
  
  # T1_StartMeet dotted line (darkgrey)
  if (!is.na(t1_idx)) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = t1_idx,
                        linetype = "dotted", color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text", x = t1_idx, y = Inf,
               label = "T1", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
               size = 3, color = "darkgrey")
  }
  
  # CP lines + interval rectangles
  if (nrow(hits) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(data = hits, aes(xintercept = cpt, color = label),
                 linetype = 1, linewidth = 1) +
      geom_rect(data = hits,
                aes(xmin = s, xmax = e, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, color = label),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    labs(title = paste(id, "– WBS changepoints (satisfaction_imp)"),
         x = "Time index", y = "satisfaction_imp",
         color = "CP [interval], |CUSUM|") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
          legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.text      = element_text(size = 9)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3,
                                override.aes = list(linetype = 1, linewidth = 1.2)))
  
  plot_path <- file.path(OutDir, paste0(id, "_WBS_satisfaction_imp.png"))
  ggsave(plot_path, plot = p, width = 10, height = 5)
  cat("  Plot saved:", plot_path, "\n")
  
  # ── 6. Collect results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (length(cp) > 0 && nrow(hits) > 0) {
    cp_df <- hits %>%
      select(cpt, s, e, CUSUM, strength) %>%
      mutate(
        Studienummer   = id,
        dep_var        = "satisfaction_imp",
        n_obs          = length(y),
        n_cp           = length(cp),

      )
  } else {
    cp_df <- data.frame(
      cpt = NA, s = NA, e = NA, CUSUM = NA, strength = NA,

      n_obs         = length(y), n_cp = 0,
      penalty       = "ssic.penalty", th.const = 1.3, Kmax = 2,
     T1  = ifelse(is.na(t1_idx),      NA_integer_, as.integer(t1_idx)),
       T2  = ifelse(is.na(phase_B_idx), NA_integer_, as.integer(phase_B_idx))
      
    )
  }
  
  cp_results_list[[id]] <- cp_df
}

# ── 7. Combine & save as Excel ───────────────────────────────────────────────
cp_results_table <- do.call(rbind, cp_results_list)
rownames(cp_results_table) <- NULL

# Reorder columns for readability
cp_results_table <- cp_results_table %>%
  select(Studienummer, dep_var, n_obs, n_cp,
         cpt, s, e, CUSUM, strength,
         T1, T2,
         penalty, th.const, Kmax)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "WBS_results")

# Header style
hs <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, textDecoration = "bold",
                  fgFill = "#D9E1F2", halign = "center",
                  border = "Bottom", borderStyle = "medium")

writeData(wb, "WBS_results", cp_results_table, headerStyle = hs)

# Body style
body_style <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10)
addStyle(wb, "WBS_results", body_style,
         rows = 2:(nrow(cp_results_table) + 1),
         cols = 1:ncol(cp_results_table),
         gridExpand = TRUE)

# Highlight the two time columns
highlight <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, fgFill = "#FFF2CC")
addStyle(wb, "WBS_results", highlight,
         rows = 2:(nrow(cp_results_table) + 1),
         cols = which(names(cp_results_table) %in% c("time_phase_B", "time_T1_start")),
         gridExpand = TRUE)

setColWidths(wb, "WBS_results", cols = 1:ncol(cp_results_table), widths = "auto")

xlsx_path <- file.path(OutDir, "2026-04-01_WBS_satisfaction_imp_changepoints.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, xlsx_path, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nResults saved to:", xlsx_path, "\n")
```
